description: This file defines the DroppingStream class, a stream decorator implementing the StreamInterface that drops data once the maximum size is reached.

classes.name: DroppingStream
classes.description: A stream decorator that drops data when the underlying stream exceeds a specified maximum length.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new DroppingStream with the underlying stream and maximum allowed length.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the underlying stream, dropping excess data if the maximum length is exceeded.
